items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...There was a picture of Mae West.

ctx.x: With George Walker and Williams and Walker -- no, I never saw them and never met them, but I -- I never saw George Walker and Ada Walker, but I knew Bert Williams and Mrs. Williams because she came to the ship with me when I sailed for Europe the first time, Bert Williams' wife with his nieces because, as I say, she went with me, his oldest niece, Lottie.
Uh-huh. I saw a thing in the Chicago Defender, an article. There was a picture of Mae West.
There was a picture of Ada Overton Walker. And it said, Ada Overton Walker was the real queen of Paris.
